reason: Both use unconventional literal body-part wording to emphasize a high price. Hotel and ticket differ in topic, while the emphatic price-expression ability is shared. Similar possible L1 influence on uncertainty does not justify merging the uncertainty group.
pattern_description: The learner has used literal body-part formulations to emphasize that something is expensive. The repeated wording is consistent with Portuguese-like price expressions, while the production cause remains unobserved and conventional nonidiomatic alternatives are also acceptable.
conversation_contexts: Compare travel costs and explain which options feel expensive
Discuss whether a purchase offers reasonable value
